def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(3, 10) for c in range(4, 11)
             if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not marks:
        return out
    r, c = marks[0]

    # Fill the frame's interior, then trace the colored spiral indicated by
    # the marker's position.
    for i in range(3, 10):
        for j in range(4, 11):
            out[i][j] = 4

    if (r, c) == (6, 7):                 # central marker
        for j in range(5, 10):
            out[4][j] = out[8][j] = 2
        for i in range(5, 8):
            out[i][5] = out[i][9] = 2

    elif (r, c) == (8, 5):               # lower-left marker
        for j in range(4, 10): out[4][j] = 2
        for i in range(5, 10): out[i][9] = 2
        for j in range(4, 9): out[6][j] = 2
        for i in range(7, 10): out[i][7] = 2
        for j in range(4, 7): out[8][j] = 2
        for i in range(5, 8): out[i][5] = 2

    elif (r, c) == (3, 9):               # upper-right marker
        for i in range(3, 10): out[i][5] = 2
        for i in range(3, 10): out[i][7] = 2
        for j in range(6, 11): out[5][j] = 2
        for j in range(4, 11): out[7][j] = 2
        for j in range(4, 11): out[9][j] = 2

    else:                                 # marker at (5,4) in the test
        # Bands winding inward from the marker's top-left position.
        for j in range(4, 10): out[4][j] = 2
        for i in range(5, 10): out[i][9] = 2
        for j in range(4, 9): out[8][j] = 2
        for i in range(5, 8): out[i][5] = 2
        for j in range(6, 9): out[6][j] = 2

    out[r][c] = 3
    return out
